entities.name: FtsH ATP-dependent protease
observations: 690-aa query matches reviewed bacterial FtsH at 61.3% identity and 98.0% coverage; E-value 1.28e-274.
Pfam identifies FtsH_ext (11–109), AAA ATPase (204–336), AAA lid, and Peptidase_M41 (417–606) domains.
Homolog annotations indicate membrane-associated, cytoplasmic-facing ATP-dependent zinc metalloprotease involved in membrane-protein quality control and proteolysis.
